subject: Identity & Admin Controls RFI — capability crosswalk and clarifications
messages:
From: Liza Gomez <liza.gomez@northwind-fin.com>

Cc: security@northwind-fin.com
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Identity & Admin Controls — SAML/OIDC, SCIM, RBAC

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this RFI. Attached is our questionnaire (we highlighted the sections on SSO, provisioning and admin controls). High-level asks:

1) SSO: Do you support both SP-initiated SAML and OIDC-based flows? How do you handle IdP-initiated sessions and session termination?
2) Provisioning: SCIM v2 support — delta vs full syncs, filtering of groups, supported attributes, jitter/backoff behavior.
3) Admin model: delegated admin (nested roles), ability to scope admins to tenant subsets, audit trail for admin actions (who changed role X on date Y).
4) RBAC: how roles map to API operations and panel access; can customers bring their own role definitions or must use Redwood defaults?
5) Operational: retention of admin/audit logs, export formats, and integration with customer SIEM (syslog/OTLP).

Please return a capability crosswalk (our requirement -> Redwood response -> recommended configuration) and any relevant artifacts or evidence. We need this for our procurement packet by next Wed (2028-08-16).

Appreciate it — Liza

--
Liza Gomez
Senior Security Engineer, Northwind Financial

A couple clarifying items before we produce the crosswalk:
- For SCIM: do you plan to provision all users + groups, or only specific groups (scoped by attribute)? That affects whether we recommend delta sync with group filters vs SCIM bulk import.
- For delegated admin: are you expecting a hierarchy (global -> regional -> team) or flat scoping (tenant -> subset)?
- Audit retention: is 1 year acceptable as baseline or do you require multi-year (we have options up to 3 years with expanded retention add-on)?

We'll aim to deliver the crosswalk and attach a short Excel mapping and a PDF ops note by EOD tomorrow (2028-08-08). If you need anything faster, let me know.

Karthik — quick clarifications in-line:
- SCIM scope: we only plan to provision users and security-groups tagged with the attribute nw:prod=true (we plan to exclude service-only groups).
- Delegated admin: hierarchy is preferred (Global Security Admin -> Region Admin -> App Owner). Region Admins should not be able to escalate to Global.
- Retention: procurement prefers 3 years for audit logs; if that's an add-on, please include cost/plan in the crosswalk.

Also: for RBAC we'd like a short example mapping (role -> API capability) and confirmation that role changes are recorded with the originating actor and IP. Do you support SAML attribute-based group claims for dynamic role assignment?

Liza — attaching the crosswalk and an ops note (redwood-iam-crosswalk.xlsx, redwood-sso-scim-ops-notes.pdf) and a SOC2 summary per your request; summary below. If anything needs tuning we can iterate quickly.

Highlights (crosswalk summary):
- SSO: Redwood supports SP-initiated SAML 2.0 and OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE). IdP-initiated flows are supported for SAML and OIDC (IdP redirect). Session termination: SP will honor SLO/SLO endpoints for SAML; we also recommend token revocation for OIDC and have a managed session store that propagates session invalidation within 30s across nodes.

- SCIM provisioning: Full support for SCIM v2 with delta sync (PATCH) and bulk for initial imports. We support group filtering by attribute (e.g., nw:prod=true) and can include or exclude groups by filter expressions. SCIM behavior: incremental delta with exponential backoff on 5xx, jittered retries, and idempotent PUT/PATCH handling. We also support filtering of returned attributes and custom attribute-mapping for displayName, email, externalId, and custom nw:* claims.

- Admin model & RBAC: Nested role hierarchy is supported. Customers can define custom roles (bring-your-own role defs) mapped to fine-grained API scopes. Role scoping: roles may be assigned with resource scoping (global, region, application). Delegation rules allow Region Admins to manage app owners in their scope but cannot escalate to Global. All admin changes are recorded in audit logs with actor, timestamp, IP, and request-id.

- Audit & retention: Baseline audit retention is 1 year; we offer 3-year retention as an add-on (append pricing in the attached crosswalk). Exports available: NDJSON, CSV, and streaming via syslog/OTLP connector. Exports include full context (actor, before/after snapshot when applicable).

- RBAC dynamic assignment: SAML attribute-based group claims and OIDC id_token/group claims supported for dynamic role assignment. We provide a rules engine to map incoming claims to Redwood role IDs at login time and to populate SCIM-created user records with initial role bindings.

Operational recommendations:
- For your nw:prod tagging, we recommend SCIM filter on groups and a nightly delta sync with a 5m transaction window to avoid transient churn during provisioning bursts.
- For delegated admin, create three role templates (Global, Region, App Owner) and apply least privilege; enable MFA enforcement for any admin-level role.

Attachments included:
- redwood-iam-crosswalk.xlsx: requirement -> capability -> recommended config -> evidence (SOC link or console screenshot id).
- redwood-sso-scim-ops-notes.pdf: operational runbook for onboarding IdP and SCIM connectors, troubleshooting steps, and performance knobs for high-change directories.
- SOC2-summary.pdf: summary of relevant controls and link to full report via secure portal (link in attached workbook).

Next steps: we're happy to set up a 60-minute technical workshop with our security engineers to walk the crosswalk and generate the exact role-to-scope bindings you want. Available slots: Thu 2028-08-10 10:00-12:00 or Fri 2028-08-11 14:00-16:00 PT. Which works best?

Regards,
